# Linear Transformations — How Rules Change Vectors

Book Chapter 5 develops linear maps, their matrix representations, basis changes and the invertible matrix theorem. A map is defined by what it does to a basis.

## Follow the chapters

1. [what linearity means](01-what-linearity-means.qmd)
2. [change of basis](02-change-of-basis.qmd)
3. [invertibility and rank](03-invertibility-and-rank.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Linear Transformations — How Rules Change Vectors. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
